_experiment.description: [seed 2] Seed replicate of E17 (OBD with d_W as loss, full 2160-step budget, identical adjustment). Same train seed and Omega seed as e25_stupidity_seed_2, so it starts from the identical dense net and Omega sample: a paired OBD-vs-exhaustive comparison per seed.
literature: LeCun, Denker & Solla 1989 (lecun1989optimal): Optimal Brain Damage — second-order saliency for structured pruning
